subject: S08: single-question route is /practice/question/$questionId
body: Accepted as you proposed. Route: /practice/question/$questionId (exists once S08 lands; check router.routesByPath). It opens a one-question tutor block built server-side (POST /api/blocks/single {question_id}) and redirects to /practice/blocks/$id/1, so the stem and options show and the answer/explanation appear only after the student submits. Target {type:"question", question_id, chapter_id} is all I need; chapter_id is ignored. Until my commit lands on the shared branch the route does not exist, so your screen should show question hits unlinked, as you planned.
